Oliver Tran: Need to close a 3-month contract for an SRE contractor in Mexico. Candidate prefers MXN invoice. Manager proposes MXN-equivalent to S3 cap + 8% premium, one-time remote equipment stipend MXN 8,000, start target 2026-10-05. Background check pending.
Rhea Desai: Geo premium <10% so finance director ok, but MXN invoice vs EoR matters for payroll and benefits bridge. If invoiced, we need supplier onboarding + VAT docs. Can you share cost_center and total MXN outflow? Also note: background check delays push start.
Oliver Tran: cost_center: ENG-SRE-710, budget_owner: Oliver Tran. Total cash = MXN 300,000 pro-rated + MXN 8,000 stipend = MXN 308,000. No PO (vendor invoice). Background check estimated 5 business days.
Mateo Vargas: Finance: vendor invoice route requires supplier onboarding and AML docs; director sign-off required for any supplier payment > MXN 250k. Routing should be people-ops -> finance -> legal for IR risk and supplier docs. Ping offers-bot for ticket.
offers-bot: Approval request created: APP-9876. Routing: people-ops -> finance -> legal. https://redwood.in/offers/APP-9876
Sergio Lopez: Legal: flag on IP assignment + local contractor law. If vendor invoices from MX entity, ensure contract includes strict deliverables and IP assignment. Also recommend EoR if we want faster onboarding and to avoid VAT complexity. Any objections to EoR option?
Oliver Tran: Candidate prefers invoice but is open to EoR if total net is comparable. Manager requests speed; background check could delay. Can People Ops recommend EoR and present gross MXN equivalence?
Rhea Desai: I'll ask EoR ops for gross MXN calc. Meanwhile I'll add supplier checklist to APP-9876 and request AML docs. Also note: benefits bridge not applicable for vendors; only possible via EoR. If candidate insists on invoice, include contractor addendum with IP and 90-day conversion clause.
backgroundcheck-bot: Background check for candidate started at 3167890140. Estimated clear by 3167890360.
Mateo Vargas: Finance provisional: MXN 308,000 OK pending supplier onboarding docs or EoR gross calc. Director approval for >MXN 250k acknowledged, routing to director now. :white_check_mark:
Sergio Lopez: Drafted IP + deliverables clause and 90-day conversion/addendum. Uploading to APP-9876. Recommend clawback language on stipend if onboarding fails or conversion not agreed within 90 days.
Rhea Desai: Added clawback clause and updated APP-9876 with EoR gross equivalence estimate. ETA to finalize offer: contingent on supplier docs OR EoR confirmation and background check clear. If BG clears today and EoR calc confirmed, People Ops can send same-day.
Oliver Tran: Please keep vendor invoice as fallback but prioritize EoR for speed. Manager will be ready to approve final offer ASAP.
offers-bot: APP-9876 status: routed to Finance Director and Legal at 3167890170.
Mateo Vargas: Director approved provisional payout method as EoR preferred for compliance; vendor invoice allowed if supplier onboarding completes by 3167890340. :thumbsup:
backgroundcheck-bot: Background check cleared at 3167890360.
Rhea Desai: Final check done. Supplier onboarding not ready, EoR calc confirmed. People Ops will send EoR-structured offer showing gross MXN amounts and include equipment stipend & IP clause. Decision window: 48 hours. offers-bot: APP-9876 closed: Offer cleared to send at 3167890189.
